events.name: Jazz Night: Bulatkin, Herak, & Guests [concert: Offbeat Bohemia]
events.venue: Czech Center New York (New York, NY)
events.description: Daniel Bulatkin and Miro Herak bring bold jazz and folk roots to the stage with New York guests Ben Tiberio and Ofri Nehemya.

events.name: Birds, Orphans and Fools [screening + conversation w/ Magda Vášáryová]
events.description: A surreal anti-war classic from the Czechoslovak New Wave, followed by a conversation with acclaimed actress Magda Vášáryová.

events.name: Echoes of Kafka Contemporary Opera [concert: Offbeat Bohemia]
events.description: Kafka meets contemporary sound: Jiří Trtík’s opera music and Never Sol’s haunting vocals in an immersive night of piano and electronics.

events.name: Cantata – Dance of the Insane [concert]
events.description: Bach meets Arnošt Lustig’s unpublished poetry in a U.S. premiere of music and spoken word featuring Grammy winner Paul Bogaev.

events.name: Oscar Night: If Pigeons Turned to Gold [screening + Q&A w/ producer]
events.description: Czechia’s Oscar submission returns to Czech Center Cinema for a second screening and Q&A with producer Klára Mamojková.

events.name: Mannes Sounds: Leoš Janáček [concert]
events.description: Young Mannes artists perform opera and instrumental works by Janáček, his musical heroes, and the composers he inspired.

events.name: NYC Jewelry Week [exhibition opening]
events.description: Start NYC Jewelry Week with a closer look at the pieces on display and conversations with the people who created them.

events.name: Visual Voices [exhibition artist panel]
events.description: What happens between the first idea and the finished piece? Hear from the makers, ask questions, and discover their creative processes.

events.name: NYC Jewelry Week [exhibition closing]
events.description: Still thinking about a piece you saw? Return for a final browse, explore something new, or choose a work to take home.

events.name: Oscar Night: 9 Million Colors, Volklore [screenings + Q&A w/ directors]
events.description: An underwater musical, folklore with a digital twist, and two filmmakers in person. Discover Czech shorts in the Oscar race + Q&A.

events.description: The global New Year's Eve celebration featuring live star performances, commercial hourly countdowns, and the midnight crystal ball drop.

events.description: Traditional firecrackers to ward off evil spirits, lion dance troupes, martial arts, and cultural performances welcoming the New Year.

events.description: The world's oldest and largest civilian parade, marching up Fifth Avenue past St. Patrick's Cathedral with bands, bagpipes, and Irish societies.

events.description: Fifth Avenue is closed to traffic for 28 blocks as 8 world-class museums (The Met, Guggenheim, Cooper Hewitt, El Museo, etc.) open free to the public.

events.name: 45th Annual Coney Island Mermaid Parade
events.description: The nation's largest art parade celebrating marine mythology and artistic self-expression on the historic Coney Island Boardwalk.

events.name: NYC Pride March 2027
events.description: The monumental annual civil rights march from 25th St down 5th Ave past the Stonewall National Monument to 16th St.
